description:
REVIEWED 2026-10-25 (TodoReview) against origin/develop 9a184b619 and fork main ea44bcc9 (30.24.0.13). PROBLEM
Anonymous registry pulls from shared GitHub runner IPs hit Docker Hub/ECR rate limits (`toomanyrequests`). The Postgres service in sql-execution-evidence is owned by ci-sql-evidence-postgres-ecr-rate-limit-20261022 (PR #3455). This item covers every OTHER anonymous pull in required jobs.

VERIFIED FACTS (2026-10-25, workflows on origin/develop 9a184b619)
- Exactly one other anonymous Docker Hub pull remains in a required job: ci.yml job `code-lint` (displayed as `lint`) service `questdb/questdb:10.0.1@sha256:67eaed863ebb2383227919ea9a5499a4a39ceca3862c20b974c84a10e11cdf89` (ci.yml about lines 604-606), used by the step running `make sqlglot-repro-retirement-check` with BENCHBOX_QUESTDB_DSN. The ECR Postgres service is at about ci.yml:1335-1337 and belongs to the ECR item.
- No other workflow image refs need change: nightly.yml postgres is already `ghcr.io/benchbox-dev/postgres:17@sha256:2d2b8998...` with job-token credentials; docker-integration.yml and nightly-v2.yml set CLICKHOUSE_IMAGE, TRINO_IMAGE and POSTGRES_IMAGE to ghcr.io mirrors (the compose files default to Docker Hub/ECR only for local use when the env var is absent). `core` is an aggregate: it pulls no image itself and fails only when a dependent job (lint, sql-execution-evidence) fails.
- Evidence check: of the 12 most recent failed ci.yml runs listed on 2026-10-25, one (run 40170713453) failed on `toomanyrequests` and it was the ECR Postgres pull in sql-execution-evidence; none showed a Docker Hub failure for the questdb pull. The original statement that the lint/core jobs 'repeatedly failed on Docker Hub' is therefore unproven; this item is preventive hardening and is rated low.
- mirror-ci-images.yml supports clickhouse, trino, cedardb, postgres and postgres17 (case list); a QuestDB case does not exist. The first postgres17 seed itself hit the ECR limit (nightly run 40184112549) and needed #3449 fallbacks plus an owner hand-seed, so a QuestDB mirror may also need an owner hand-seed.
- Fork CI (BenchBox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot benchbox-engines.yml) separately pulls postgres:16, trinodb/trino:484, questdb, starrocks and doris anonymously from Docker Hub; that repo is out of scope unless the owner opts in.

DECISION GATES (stop and ask the owner)
G1 Mechanism. Options: (a) mirror QuestDB to ghcr.io/benchbox-dev/questdb through mirror-ci-images.yml (strict same-digest check) and pull with job-token credentials (recommended; same pattern as Postgres); (b) authenticate to Docker Hub with a repository secret (creates a credential: owner action); (c) leave as is and accept the risk.
G2 Owner actions this needs: seeding the first GHCR copy if the source registry rate-limits, and GHCR package write/visibility settings.
G3 Include the fork's CI images? Default: no.

GUARDRAILS
- Keep every image pinned by digest; never switch to a tag; the mirrored digest must equal `sha256:67eaed86...cdf89`.
- Do not touch the Postgres image lines or mirror-postgres17 (ECR item); start only after #3455 has merged to avoid ci.yml conflicts.
- Minimal job permissions (`packages: read`) and no new secrets without owner approval; keep the `lint` job otherwise unchanged.

STANDING GUARDRAILS: work only in a `make worktree-create` worktree after `make agent-write-preflight` (primary clone /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox is read-only); run tests only through make targets (`make test-fast`, `make pr-preflight`, `make sql-execution-gate`, `make tpcds-obt-equivalence`) or targeted `uv run -- python -m pytest <paths> -n 4`; never BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR, `make test-unlock` or raw broad runs; one heavy run at a time; no live-cloud spend and no production publish without explicit owner approval; published result bundles are never edited (only manifest-sidecar `known_defects` and results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md per results-data/DEFECTIVE_DATAGEN_AUDIT.md); no SKIP / --no-verify / `git add -A`; no explanatory comments or docstrings in code (`make comment-policy-check`); uv only; identity Joe Harris, no Co-Authored-By; PR flow `make pr-preflight` once, `make pr-open`, CI + oracle review, `make pr-arm`. Stop and ask the owner on unexpected result changes, relaxed guards, oracle stand-ins or real design choices.
